title: Staff Accountant
plainDescription:
Why Choose to Work with Us
At SMG ABA LLC, we take pride in being more than just an accounting firm. We foster a unique team spirit that sets us apart from our competitors. Guided by a set of core values, we have established ourselves as a seven-time Inc. 5000 company, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to success and continuous growth. With headquarters in Islandia, New York, and additional offices in New York City and St. Petersburg, Florida, we offer a dynamic and vibrant work environment.
As part of the SMG ABA team, you will be surrounded by individuals who value hard work, encourage personal and professional growth, and celebrate achievements together. We recognize the importance of each team member's contributions and provide a supportive atmosphere where your efforts are acknowledged and rewarded when we reach our goals.
What You Will Do as a Staff Tax Accountant

Prepare a wide range of tax returns, including corporate, partnership, and individual returns, demonstrating attention to detail and accuracy.
Conduct tax planning and research to identify opportunities for tax savings and minimize tax liabilities for our clients.
Collaborate with clients to gather necessary tax-related information, address inquiries, and provide exceptional client service.
Stay updated on changes in tax laws and regulations to ensure compliance and incorporate any relevant updates into tax strategies.
Assist in the resolution of tax-related issues and inquiries from tax authorities on behalf of our clients.
Contribute to the development and improvement of tax processes and procedures, identifying opportunities for enhanced efficiency and effectiveness.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior team members.
Participate in SMG ABA team-building and other firm events/efforts

Qualifications and Attributes You Will Need

Possess a minimum of 2 years of experience in tax preparation and planning, preferably in a public accounting firm.
Intermediate knowledge of tax rules and regulations.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA license is a plus.
Proficient in tax software and accounting systems, with a good understanding of technology tools used in tax preparation and research.
Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to navigate complex tax scenarios and provide innovative solutions.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, to effectively communicate tax concepts to clients and colleagues.
Client-focused mindset, dedicated to delivering exceptional service and further developing & maintaining long-term client relationships.
Detail-oriented and deadline-driven, ensuring accuracy and timely completion of tax deliverables.
Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.

title: Bookkeeper
plainDescription:
At SMG ABA LLC, we take pride in being more than just an accounting firm. We foster a unique team spirit that sets us apart from our competitors. Guided by a set of core values, we have established ourselves as a seven-time Inc. 5000 company, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to success and continuous growth. With headquarters in Islandia, New York, and additional offices in New York City and St. Petersburg, Florida, we offer a dynamic and vibrant work environment.
 
As part of the SMG ABA team, you will be surrounded by individuals who value hard work, encourage personal and professional growth, and celebrate achievements together. We recognize the importance of each team member's contributions and provide a supportive atmosphere where your efforts are acknowledged and rewarded when we reach our goals.
What you will do as a Bookkeeper

Reconcile multiple clients' accounts on a daily/weekly basis, ensuring accuracy and completeness
Record entries from point-of-sale systems, maintaining meticulous records of financial transactions
Handle weekly payroll processing, ensuring accurate and timely recording of payroll clearings.
Perform bank, credit card, and loan account reconciliations, identifying and resolving discrepancies
Manage accounts payable functions, including recording vendor invoices, debit memos, and processing check payments
Handle accounts receivable tasks, including recording customer invoices, credit memos, refunds, and payments
Utilize bank feed and download features, mapping and coding accounts for streamlined and efficient processes
Generate weekly/monthly profit and loss reports and comparative analyses to identify irregularities and potential areas for improvement.
Assist with payroll tax and sales tax preparation functions, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements
Contribute to monthly closeout procedures by reconciling payable, prepaid, and accrual entries

title: Administrator
plainDescription:
Why Choose to Work with Us At SMG ABA LLC, we take pride in being more than just an accounting firm. We foster a unique team spirit that sets us apart from our competitors. Guided by a set of core values, we have established ourselves as a six-time Inc. 5000 company, demonstrating our unwavering commitment to success and continuous growth. With headquarters in Islandia, New York, and additional offices in New York City and St. Petersburg, Florida, we offer a dynamic and vibrant work environment.
As part of the SMG ABA team, you will be surrounded by individuals who value hard work, encourage personal and professional growth, and celebrate achievements together. We recognize the importance of each team member's contributions and provide a supportive atmosphere where your efforts are acknowledged and rewarded when we reach our goals.
Job Summary:
The Administrator  plays a critical role in supporting firm operations, client service, tax workflow coordination, billing, and office management. This position serves as the first point of contact for clients and ensures smooth day-to-day administrative execution.
Office & Front Desk Management

Greet clients and vendors in a professional, friendly manner and offer refreshments.
Answer incoming calls and route messages appropriately, including government agency calls
Manage the Admin Inbox and monitor voicemail
Maintain a clean, organized, and welcoming front office environment, including conference rooms and common areas.
Plan, coordinate, and order lunches/dinners during tax season; confirm partners' preferences and needs. 
Monitor office, kitchen, and supply inventory; perform weekly inventory checks and coordinate reorders
Restock kitchen, bathrooms, private offices, and shared spaces
Water office plants weekly
Maintain kitchen cleanliness: run dishwasher, clean sink, manage garbage, and discard expired food.
Receive and distribute incoming mail and packages
Prepare and track outgoing mail, including certified mail, FedEx, UPS, and client checks
Manage mailings and postage (Stamps.com)
Track and reconcile petty cash

 
Tax Administration Support

Monitor the Tax Data Inbox and organize incoming documentation
Create, label, and maintain digital and physical client tax folders
Update client statuses and create, update, or close jobs in Axcess
Send and follow up on e-file authorizations
Scan, save, and prepare documents for E-Filing
Process completed tax returns (email and physical delivery)
Coordinate client payments (credit card and ACH)
Prepare Powers of Attorney (POAs), route for signature, and submit to IRS
Maintain organized client documentation and backup files
Support recurring tax reporting tasks and seasonal workflows

 
Client Billing & Lifecycle Support

Prepare and manage monthly client billing
Process client renewals and update engagement terms
Maintain billing data in QBO, Axcess, and internal tracking systems
Monitor accounts receivable (A/R), send payment reminders, and maintain collections log
Manage NY and FL QuickBooks Online subscription billbacks
Manage subscription billbacks
Handle client terminations, update records, deactivate billing, and archive folders

 
Vendor & Firm Operations Support

Monitor and process recurring firm overhead payments (utilities, software subscriptions, etc.)
Track vendor due dates and ensure timely payments
Maintain organized records of invoices, receipts, and confirmations
Monitor Axcess projects and File Holder reports; update task statuses
Maintain organized server files and directories
Update and maintain internal SOPs and workflow documentation
Monitor Axcess and Bitwarden Teams channels for incoming requests
Provide backup administrative support as needed

 
Qualifications and Attributes You Will Need

High school diploma required; associate or bachelor's degree preferred
Previous administrative experience required (accounting or financial services preferred)
Strong organizational and time management skills
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint)
Experience with QuickBooks Online and accounting software preferred
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and recordkeeping
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment
Strong problem-solving skills
Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

Benefits and Perks of Joining the SMG ABA Team
At SMG ABA, we value our team members and offer a comprehensive benefits package to support their well-being and professional growth. Joining our team comes with the following perks:

Near-100% Employer-Paid Medical Premiums: Outstanding medical insurance coverage for team members with dental and vision options.
401(k) Retirement Plan: Future-focused retirement savings plan featuring direct employer matching.
Ancillary Insurance Options: Flexible additional coverage choices tailored to your personal needs.
Immediate PTO Accrual: Paid time off hours begin building from day one, allowing you to recharge and maintain work-life balance.
8 Company-Paid Holidays: Designated paid time off to celebrate major holidays throughout the year.
Summer Hours Program: Enjoy half-day Fridays during the summer months to offset the long hours worked during tax season.
Tax Season Meals: Enjoy complimentary, company-paid meals provided directly to the team during the busy tax season.
Summer Lunch-and-Learns: Company-paid educational lunch sessions designed to collaborate and identify operational areas of improvement.
Onsite Continuing Education: Paid professional training opportunities funded entirely by the firm to enhance your technical skills.
Casual Dress Code: Come as you are! We embrace a relaxed workplace dress code-just ensure your attire remains appropriate for an office setting.
Structured Mentor Program: Direct pairing with experienced leaders to support your long-term professional development and growth.
Employee Volunteer Program: Earn additional paid time off specifically for community involvement and service.
Engaging Team-Building Events: Regular firm-sponsored outings and collaborative social events to foster a positive work environment.
